title: #198 - The Pressure Is Too Great
content:
#198 - The Pressure Is Too Great

The pressure is too great, brothers.

Let me first talk about the situation. The dog author is studying at a university in the southwest. Now he is a senior. He will take the postgraduate entrance examination in December, and he has to make up a communication principle when school starts.

In the past two months, I basically studied calculus, linear algebra, and probability theory during the day, and wrote at night.

If you divide your attention between two things, you can only do neither well.

Maybe readers have also noticed that the logic of some of the later chapters is not strong, and the writing is also very watery. Some planned excitement points were also forgotten because my mind was full of advanced mathematics.

Originally, the selling points of this book were Mount and Blade, fighting, and Game of Thrones struggle, but because I was obsessed with learning, several major selling points were not written, and long paragraphs were watered down with meaningless dialogues.

This is done to save money in the drama, and it is a bit sorry for the readers if it is still watered down in the online article.

Bang bang bang!

The dog author kowtows to everyone first.

Previously, I thought I could become a coder, and update 10,000 times a day after the release, but studying dragged me down, and I could only find time to start coding after 8 or 9 o'clock, and I would code as much as I could on the day.

This not only did not make the readers happy, but also hurt my work and rest.

After updating at around 12 o'clock every day, my brain was still active, and with the necessary steps of brushing teeth, washing face, and taking a shower, I went to bed at more than 1 o'clock, and fell asleep at almost 2 o'clock.

When I got up at 7 or 8 o'clock the next day, I was also confused, and I fell asleep after studying in the classroom for a while.

For every half an hour of study, I might have to sleep for an hour to reward myself.

How can I learn anything in this state?

So by September, I had just finished the first round of basic knowledge of advanced mathematics, and there was still a second round of a lot of practice questions, and a third round of analysis of key and difficult points.

What's worse is that I didn't learn English, politics and professional courses at all.

Although I was preparing to take the entrance exam for my school, with such a study situation, I would definitely not be able to enter December.

I am a small town test-taker. My family is not well off. I studied hard for 12 years and was admitted to a 985 university in Southwest China. If I graduate from undergraduate school without even passing the postgraduate entrance examination, I will be somewhat unwilling.

So the author is ready to take the postgraduate entrance examination with all his heart, but please rest assured that this book will not be abandoned.

Three months later, whether I pass the exam or not, I will definitely update it.

Bang bang bang!

Three more kowtows, please forgive me.
